quarter.title: Quarter
quarter.description: YYYY-QN, derived from the trade date.

sector.title: Sector
sector.description: Crosswalk sector vocabulary, e.g. defense, healthcare.

mapping_rule_id.title: Mapping rule ID
mapping_rule_id.description: Which crosswalk rule fired for this record — always traceable.

mapping_confidence.title: Mapping confidence
mapping_confidence.description: Confidence of the strongest rule that produced this record. Records whose strongest rule is 'low' are excluded from the dataset entirely (see actor README) — this field will never be 'low' here.

match_level.title: Match level
match_level.description: Always 'sector': trades and lobbying are matched on (quarter, sector) via the crosswalk, never by issuer. Lobbying filings are not about the company traded.

is_primary_mapping.title: Is primary mapping
is_primary_mapping.description: True if at least one trade in this record is at its primary sector mapping. A multi-sector ticker (HD -> retail, construction) appears in several records; count only primary ones to count each trade once.

disclosure_lag_days.title: Disclosure lag (days)
disclosure_lag_days.description: Days from the earliest trade's transaction date to its disclosure date. Null whenever that trade's filing_type is 'amendment' — an amendment's gap to the transaction date is not a meaningful disclosure lag (see actor README).

sector_lobbying_filing_count.title: Sector lobbying filing count
sector_lobbying_filing_count.description: Total lobbying filings matching this (quarter, sector) — sector-wide, not specific to this trade. When greater than lobbying.length, the evidence list was capped to the largest reported amounts.

trades.title: Trades
trades.description: Every trade by this member in this sector/quarter. Each item carries ptr_filing_id (the filing's own id), tracker_row_id (tracker dataset row hash), ptr_url, ptr_url_kind ('document' | 'portal_fallback'), member_resolution ('bioguide_id' | 'name'), is_primary_mapping, ticker, transaction_type ('buy' | 'sell' | 'exchange'), amount_range, transaction_date, disclosure_date, and filing_type ('original' | 'amendment' | null, same vocabulary as the House/Senate pipelines).

lobbying.title: Lobbying filings
lobbying.description: Lobbying filings in this sector/quarter (sector-wide, not issuer-specific), capped to the largest by reported amount; null amounts are ordered by filing_posted_date then uuid. Each item carries lda_filing_uuid, lda_url, registrant, client, issue_codes, filing_type, filing_posted_date, amount_reported, amount_reported_status ('reported' | 'not_applicable_registration' | 'not_reported'), and amount_outlier (true when amount_reported looks like a data-entry error in the source, e.g. >= $10M on a single LD-2 — flagged, never dropped or zeroed).

committees.title: Committees
committees.description: Committee assignments that produced a committee_match; empty for sector_match_only.
